Commentary.Commentary: The chase is set to begin. Keshav Maharaj leads his side on the field. Followed by Jason Roy and Jonny Bairstow who walk out to open for England. It will be Keshav Maharaj who will start with the new ball. Here we go...
... The Run Chase ...

England were listless with the ball. There was no pace on offer and the seamers had to toil on a sunny day. The bowlers were never able to dominate the proceedings they leaked apleanty and would be very disappointed with their effort overall. Liam Livingstone picked up two wicket in an over to send back the two set-batters in Rassie van der Dussen and Aiden Markram, who could've hurt them a lot towards the end. It looks to be like a good pitch to bat on with not much assistance to the bowlers. The onus is now on the England batters to start on the right foot and aim to build partnerships in the middle. It won't be an easy task. Do join us for the chase on the other side.

What an incredible innings this was from the Proteas. The visting side never looked to be in any kind of trouble. The batters were focused on building big stands and eventually set a solid platform for their middle order to go beserk in the death. Quinton de Kock departed after a brisk start, but it did not bother the visitors at all. Janneman Malan and Rassie van der Dussen took their time and stitched a solid stand of over 100 runs. Although, Malan racked up his half-century but could not convert it into a three-digit score like Rassie van der Dussen. However, Markram and van der Dussen later recorded the highest third-wicket partnership in ODIs at Durham with their stand of 151 runs. It was this pair who got them closer to the 300-run mark. Later, Miller took them over 330.

England did well in the fag end of the innings to keep the runs in control with their strategy of bowling off-pace deliveries. Nonetheless, it will be South Africa who will be the happier side heading into the break after setting a mammoth total on the scoreboard. It is their best score against England in England.

Brilliant final ball and it is a dot again! A slower length ball, outside off. Miller swings across the line but misses. The ball goes off the bounce to the keeper. Miller stands there in disbelief. However, it is a good score from South Africa. They finish with 333/5 after 50 overs!
Slower length delivery, around leg. Miller makes room and looks to swipe it away but misses. The ball hits his thigh pad and it is dot ball from Carse.

FOUR! Beats Stokes at long on and it is a crucial boundary for South Africa! A low full toss on middle. Miller hits it down the ground. Stokes runs to his right at long on and dives to stop it but the ball goes past him for a boundary.
A slower shorter-length delivery on middle. Miller pulls it towards the cow corner and gets a couple.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brydon Carse finally gets a well-deserved wicket and Heinrich Klaasen holes out at long on. This is on the shorter side, on off. It is not a slower one and is bowled at a normal pace at 136 kph. Heinrich Klaasen makes room and looks to power it over long on. However, he gets the bottom of his blade and the ball goes straight down the throat of Jason Roy at long on. Andile Phehlukwayo is the next man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Roy b Brydon Carse

Commentary.Commentary: Dot to start the final over! A slower length delivery, outside off. Heinrich Klaasen looks to reverse-scoop it but misses.

FOUR! Sam Curran has been very unfortunate in the last couple of overs. It is on the shorter side and back of a hand slower one this. Miller looks to cut but gets the underedge of his blade and the ball goes left of Buttler towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Just a single! Curran continues to bowl off-pace deliveries, on a length, on middle. Heinrich Klaasen makes room and hits it to mid off for a single.
Bangs it short and is slower in pace on middle. Heinrich Klaasen skips down the track and pulls it to deep square leg for a couple.
FOUR! Heinrich Klaasen gets this one away! Very nicely played! Curran goes for a yorker on middle. Heinrich Klaasen takes it on full and scoops it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Another slower delivery. Miller only manages to cut it to point for a single.
Back of a length, on leg. Heinrich Klaasen looks to clip it away. However, he gets the inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards the off side and a single is taken.
So, just a single to end the over! On a length, on leg. Heinrich Klaasen works it to fine leg for a single. Can South Africa reach 340 from here?
Five singles now from five balls! Shorter delivery on off. It is slower in pace and Miller pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes fuller on middle. Heinrich Klaasen clips it to deep mid-wicket for another single.
On a length, on off. Miller works it wide of long on for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Heinrich Klaasen works it to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Miller punches it to deep extra-cover for a single.
Goes fuller on off. Miller drives it to long off for a single. 11 runs from the over but it was actually a good over from Sam Curran.

FOUR! This will hurt Curran! A slower length ball on off. Miller looks to work it towards the leg side. However, the ball takes the inside edge of his blade again and it goes past the leg stump for a boundary.
A fullish delivery on middle. Heinrich Klaasen clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
On the shorter side, on off. Miller punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
On a length, on middle. Miller works it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Ohh..lucky escape for Miller there! Back of a length, around off. Miller looks to cut but gets the inside edge. The ball clips the off pole but the bails does not fall off and the ball runs away towards the fine leg fence.
Heinrich Klaasen is the new man in. Also, Sam Curran is brought back into the attack.

OUT! BOWLED! Two wickets in the over for Liam Livingstone and both the set-batters are gone now! End of a fantastic knock from Rassie van der Dussen. He has taken his team to a very good score here and walks off to a standing ovation from the crowd. This is flatter and quicker on middle. Rassie van der Dussen makes room and looks to cut it but misses. The ball shatters the stumps and England have got an opening here now!
Tossed up, around off. Rassie van der Dussen reverse-sweeps it over backward point for a couple.
David Miller is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Aiden Markram holes out and success for Liam Livingstone finally! This is tossed up on middle. Aiden Markram goes for a big slog-sweep over deep mid-wicket. However, it the longer side of the boundary and the ball does not carry all the way. Jonny Bairstow at deep mid-wicket takes a fine catch and that's an end to a very fine knock from Aiden Markram.
Commentary.Howout: c Jonny Bairstow b Liam Livingstone

Commentary.Commentary: Pitches on middle and turns away slightly. Rassie van der Dussen goes for the reverse-sweep and misses. The ball  hits his pads and goes over the keeper's head. A single taken. However, England reviews it but the Ball tracking shows that the ball is missing the stumps. So Rassie van der Dussen will continue and there is no signal of leg bye so it is another run for Rassie van der Dussen.
Darted on leg. Aiden Markram looks to reverse-sweep it but misses. However the umpire reckons that is an inside edge onto the pads. So a run is taken and a stifled appeal for an LBW is turned down.
Tad shorter on middle. Rassie van der Dussen goes deep in his crease and pulls it to long on for a single.
A single to end! 5 runs off the over then. It is floated and full, on off. Rassie van der Dussen whacks it to mid-wicket for one.
It is shorter again on middle. Aiden Markram pulls but gets a top edge there. The ball goes aerially but falls short of the long on fielder. A single taken.
Short and on off. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to work it away but misses.
A single now as this is swept to deep mid-wicket.
Around off, drilled to long on for one.

FOUR! Good shot! Nonetheless, Aiden Markram ends the over on a high with a boundary. Back of a length, on off. Aiden Markram stands tall and pulls it flat over the square leg. It takes a bounce before going over the ropes. The stand moves to 143. This is the highest third wicket partnership in ODIs at Durham.
Rassie van der Dussen could not make the most of the Free Hit. It is a short ball, around middle. Rassie van der Dussen stays leg side of the ball and pulls it to deep square leg just for a single.

NO BALL! England won't like giving away extras at this point. It is full, drifting down leg. Aiden Markram flicks it to short fine leg. They take one. The umpire signals a no ball, as the bowler oversteps. Free Hit to follow.
Ben Stokes takes the pace off this time. It is a length ball, around off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it to cover for one.
Much fuller, outside off. Aiden Markram crunches it through covers for one more.
Back of a length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to deep mid-wicket and gets a single.
Full length, on the pads, Rassie van der Dussen wrists it to deep square leg for two runs. Both the batters are finding the gaps really well.
On off, defended out.

DROPPED! Jonny Bairstow misses a golden opportunity here. It is full and on off. Rassie van der Dussen kneels and slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. Jonny Bairstow was late to judge the ball and puts in a late dive forward. The ball lands on the ground. They take one.
In the air but safe! It is tossed up, on off. Rassie van der Dussen slogs it to deep mid-wicket. They take two.
FOUR! Rassie van der Dussen has no intention of stopping here. Short ball, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen swivels on the back foot and pulls it through the gap at mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full, on leg. Markram comes down the track and flicks it to long on for a single.
Floated and full, outside off. Aiden Markram reverse-sweeps it past short third man. Two taken.
Back of a length, around the hips. Rassie van der Dussen stays back and pulls it to the left of deep square leg. The batters take two before the fielder cuts it off.
Full length, drifting down leg, Markram flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Aiden Markram is just toying with the fielders. Full length, wide outside off. Aiden Markram slashes it to the right of sweeper cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Top placement. Back of a length, on off. Markram pulls it over mid-wicket. One bounce and into the ropes.
Slower one now! Full length, wide outside off. Rassie van der Dussen covers his stumps and punches it to cover for one.
Fraction short, on off. Markram stays back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short and on middle. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to deep mid-wicket for two runs.
A yorker length delivery, on off. Markram gets it to square leg off the inside edge for one.
On off, defended out.
Floated and full, on off. Markram gets low and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. There is protection in the deep. They take two.
This one is drifting down leg. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it to deep square leg for one.
Loopy ball, on leg stump. Rassie van der Dussen shuffles across and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Powerplay 2 comes to an end. Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle until the end of the innings.
Back of a length, outside off. Aiden Markram punches it nicely wide of sweeper cover for a couple.
Back of a length, around off. Aiden Markram uses his wrists and works it wide of mid on. However, Stokes moves swiftly to his right and stops it.
Drifting on the pads and Rassie van der Dussen glances it through square leg for a single.
Bangs it short on middle. Rassie van der Dussen ducks under it.
Fifty for Aiden Markram! His fourth in ODIs, he would be looking to convert this into a big one here. On a length, on middle. Aiden Markram works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Aiden Markram advances and Carse delivers a slower length delivery down the leg side. Aiden Markram looks to clip it away but misses.
Goes fuler on middle. Rassie van der Dussen clips it to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
A slower length delivery on middle. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it out.
Two more, good running! Serves a length delivery on middle. Rassie van der Dussen just clips it in the gap towards the deep square leg region and comes back for the second run.
On the shorter side on middle. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to deep backward square leg for a couple.

FOUR! Hundred for Rassie van der Dussen! What a player he is turning out to be for South Africa. Has really developed as a bankable option for the Proteas in all conditions and now gets his first ODI hundred against England. On a length, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen just tucks it off his pads and the ball runs away towards the fine leg fence.
Goes fuller, around off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to covers.
FOUR! Connects this time and hits it away towards the fence. Carse bowls it short again on middle. Aiden Markram is hanging back on his crease and pulls it to the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Bangs it short angling into leg. Aiden Markram looks to pull but misses and the ball hits him around his gloves.
Goes fuller and outside off. Aiden Markram drives but gets the inside half of his blade to the leg side.
Pulls his length back a bit, on middle and it stops a bit off the pitch. Aiden Markram defend but is early on that defence and the ball goes aerially off his blade but short and right of the bowler.
On a length, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen glances it to fine leg for a single.
Lands on a length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to drive it away. However, he gets a thick outside edge to the third man region and comes back for the second run.

Drinks break! South Africa are in the driving seat here. Rassie van der Dussen is just 7 short of his ton, while Markram look to be in exceptional form after a slow start. The pair would be hoping to go big in the final 10. England bowlers need to find some inspiration to get them out of trouble. An enticing passage awaits. Brydon Carse comes back into the attack.
A very, very slower delivery at 89 kph down the leg side. Rassie van der Dussen works it behind square on the leg side and takes a single.
It's a good bumper on middle. However, Aiden Markram plays it equally well as he pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Curran comes over the wicket and lands on a length on middle. Aiden Markram pushes it back to the bowler.

Curran continues with the short-pitch stuff. It is around off and Rassie van der Dussen pulls it in front of square. Jonny Bairstow runs to left and makes a good stop. The batters though run three in the meanwhile.
Back of a length, on off. Aiden Markram slaps it to long on for a single.
A full toss, it is a back of a hand slower ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen is just out of his crease and works it to the wide mid on region for a single.
On the shorter side, on middle. Aiden Markram goes deep in his crease and works it to mid-wicket.
A quicker one on off. Aiden Markram reverse-sweeps and does it just over the short third man fielder. Two runs taken.
Darted on middle and leg. Rassie van der Dussen works it to square leg for a single.
A flatter one on middle. Rassie van der Dussen works it to mid-wicket.
This is fuller and outside off. Aiden Markram drives it to long off for a single.

FOUR! Aiden Markram after struggling to get his timing right early in his innings, is now looking quite comfortable. Tossed up on off. Aiden Markram skips down the track and hits it with full face of his blade straight down the ground. It almost goes all the way but falls just short of the rope and goes across it in the end.
Full length, angled into the pads, Aiden Markram hits it to long on for a single. 9 runs off the over then.
Back of a length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to deep square leg for a single. These two are making sure to keep the runs ticking.
FOUR! Edgy! It is full, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to drive it away. The ball goes to the third man fence off the outside edge.
Curran serves it on a length, on off. Aiden Markram hits it to mid off for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one. 200 up for South Africa.
Quick run! It is angled in on off. Aiden Markram flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Sam Curran is back on. Five overs for 18 runs and along with a wicket-maiden so far.
Short ball, on off. Markman gets across and punches it to mid on for a single.
FOUR! Aiden Markram is on a roll here. It is tossed up, full and on off. Aiden Markram reverse-sweeps it through backward point for a boundary.
Slower one, around off. Rassie van der Dussen hits it to long on for a single.
Looped up, on off, blocked back to the bowler.
A single now as this is worked down to long on.
On middle, flicked through mid on for one.
FOUR! This is brutal from this pair. It is short and outside off. Aiden Markram stays on the back foot and cuts it through covers for a boundary.
Flatter and on off. Aiden Markram blocks it out solidly.
FOUR! Incredible shot. It is full and on off. Aiden Markram plays a gorgeous inside-out shot. He creams it through extra cover for a boundary.
Tossed up, on off. Rassie van der Dussen gets on his front foot and drives it to long off for one.
On off, pushed to cover for one.
FOUR! Top Shot! Back of a length, outside off. Aiden Markram cuts it through point for a boundary.
Tad shorter on middle. Aiden Markram goes deep in his crease and punches it to long on for a single.
Full and on off. Rassie van der Dussen reverse-sweeps it to third man for three runs.
A single as this is worked down to long on.
On off, pushed to extra cover.
Full and on off. Rassie van der Dussen works it to mid on for a single.
Full and on off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it to cover.
Floated and on off, Aiden Markram works it to mid on.
On off, defended out.
Floated and full, on middle and leg, Rassie van der Dussen flicks it through square leg.
A single now as this is driven to covers.
Floated and full, outside off. Aiden Markram defends it out watchfully.
Floated and full, on off. Rassie van der Dussen eases it to long off for one.
Slower through the air, turning into middle. Aiden Markram works it to mid-wicket.
Goes fuller on middle. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to long on for a single.
Ali with a quicker one on off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it out.
Pushed quicker on leg. Rassie van der Dussen clips it to short fine leg.
FOUR! Lovely shot! This is short and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts and cuts it well in front of square for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle. Aiden Markram skips down the track and chips it aerially but short of long off for a single.
Liam Livingstone goes a tad short again, outside off. Aiden Markram cuts it towards deep point. Curran runs to left and dives to stop it just near the fence. Three runs taken.
A flatter one on off. Aiden Markram blocks it out.
Tossed up on off. Rassie van der Dussen knocks it down to long off for a single.
Pushed quicker on off. It is fuller and Aiden Markram looks to drive it away. He gets a thick outside edge towards short third man and a single is taken.
A leg-spinner again and slightly shorter in length, outside off. Aiden Markram cuts it left of sweeper cover for a couple.
Short and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Change. Liam Livingstone comes into the attack now.
Turning into leg. Rassie van der Dussen clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Pushed quicker on off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it off the back foot.
On the shorter side, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen makes room and cuts it to the cover fielder.
This is pushed quicker on middle. Aiden Markram knocks it down to long on for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to covers for a single.
Shorter and outside off. Aiden Markram punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Pitched outside off and it turns away sharply. Rassie van der Dussen keeps his bat inside the line of the ball.
Flighted delivery, around off. Aiden Markram defends it with soft hands towards the off side for a single.
Landing on middle and turning in. Rassie van der Dussen goes deep in his crease and works it to deep backward square leg for a single.
This is pitched outside off and it turns back in. Aiden Markram manages to chop it towards covers for a single.
Slower through the air, on off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to long off for a single.
This is a leg-spinner, around off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge to point.
Floated up again, on middle. Aiden Markram drives it to mid on.
Slower through the air, on off. Aiden Markram defends it off the front foot.
Pushed quicker on middle. Rassie van der Dussen works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Aiden Markram comes in at number 4.

OUT! CAUGHT! Janneman Malan departs and a clever change of bowling from Buttler has worked here! Ali tosses this up and gives Malan an invitation to take him on Malan decides to go after it and skips down the track. He, however, looks to launch it over deep mid-wicket and given the big boundaries in this ground, the ball fails to travel the distance. Liam Livingstone is there in the deep mid-wicket and the ball goes straight into his hands. Liam Livingstone takes the catch and England finally break this big partnership!
Commentary.Howout: c Liam Livingstone b Moeen Ali

Commentary.Commentary: Slower through the air, on off. Malan reverse-sweeps it to backward point.
A flatter one on middle. Rassie van der Dussen works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated and full, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played. Tossed up, full and on off. Rassie van der Dussen lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Flighted and full, on off. Malan sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Another single now as this is driven to wide of long off.
Loopy ball, full and outside off. Malan gets forward and drives it along the ground to mid off for a single.
Floated and full, on off. Malan fends it to covers.
Full length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen defends it back to the bowler.
Full length, wide outside off. Rassie van der Dussen leans in and drives it to sweeper cover for two runs now.
Full length, angled in, around off. Malan drives it to sweeper cover for a single.

Janneman Malan seems to have hurt his knee here. The dive he made has hurt his knee and the physio comes out now and this allows the players to take a quick drinks break. South Africa are going along nicely here. Both Janneman Malan and Rassie van der Dussen are looking in fine touch and England need wickets to put South Africa under some pressure. The pitch is on the slower side and England would be hoping that their spinners do the job in a hot summer day at Chester-Le-Street. In the meanwhile, here is Brydon Carse charging in again.

A length ball, on off. Malan pushes it back to the bowler. Carse gets low and collects it on a bounce. Janneman Malan turns around and stretches his hand out to get inside the crease before Carse gets his throw in. The throw is wide but Malan is on the floor, looks like he hurt his knee.
Back of a length, on off. Malan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for two runs. Liam Livingstone does well to cover the ground in the deep.
Full length, outside off. Malan drives it to covers on the front foot.
Brydon Carse to continue.
Darted on the pads, Rassie van der Dussen goes back and nudges it to mid-wicket.
First dot of the over! It is a googly, wide outside off. Rassie van der Dussen goes for the drive but gets it to square leg off the inner half.
Flighted and full, outside off. Malan gets down the track and drives it to mid off for a single.
Full and on the pads, Rassie van der Dussen clips it through square leg for one.
Pushed quicker on middle. Malan works it to long on for a single.

Fifty for Rassie van der Dussen. This pair has been exceptional. It is full and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen gets on his front foot and pushes it to mid off for a single. He would be aiming to get to three digits soon.
Full length, angled in around off. Malan gets on his front foot and pushes it gently towards cover. Just 4 runs off the over, a tidy one by Carse.
Full length, outside off, nips in a touch. Malan slaps it to mid off.
Length and on off, defended out.

Back of a length, on middle. Janneman Malan pulls it to deep square leg. He is enough time to get back for the second run and he records his fourth half-century in ODIs. He seems to have his eye-in and would be aiming to go big.
Good length, just outside off. Malan gets on top of the bounce and punches it to mid on.
Carse dishes a full-length delivery, outside off. Malan reaches out and strokes it through covers. They take two.
An expensive over by Rashid. 10 runs off it. It is darted on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen stays back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Floated and full, on middle and leg. Malan nurdles it to mid-wicket for one more.
A single as this is flicked towards mid-wicket.
WIDE! Tossed up, wide outside off, turning away. Rassie van der Dussen leaves it alone. Wided.
FOUR! Up and over! Flighted and full, around off. Rassie van der Dussen lofts it over mid-wicket against the spin. It goes into the boundary. He moves to 47.
Slower through the air, full and on off. Rassie van der Dussen defends it out.
Looped up, full and around leg. Malan looks to flick but gets it to mid on off the leading edge. They cross for one.
Pulls his length back a bit, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it with angled blade through point for a couple.
Carse with a fullish delivery on middle. Rassie van der Dussen works it to mid-wicket.
Goes wider of the crease and angles a length delivery on middle. Rassie van der Dussen looks to clip it away. However, he gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Lands on a length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it out solidly.
Goes fuller and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to covers.
Carse starts off with his favourite length, i.e back of a length, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Rashid is bowling nice loopy flighted deliveries here. This one is outside off. Rassie van der Dussen leans forward and drives it to long off for another single.
Bit quicker this time, around off. Malan drives it to long off for a single.
Floats up in the air and outside off. Malan leaves it alone.
Nice loopy leg-spinner on off. Malan drives it wide of long off for a couple.
Flighted delivery on off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to long off for a single.
Slower through the air, on off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it out.
WIDE! This is pushed quicker but way down the leg side. Rassie van der Dussen looks to clip it away but misses.
Bouncer to end the over, on off. Malan ducks under it.
Keeps it a tad short again, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, angling into middle. Malan looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits his body and rolls towards the leg side. A leg bye taken.
FOUR! Another quality shot, this time from Malan! Bit on the shorter side on middle. Malan skips down the track, gets on the top of the bounce and powers it  past mid on for a boundary.
Shorter in length and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot, one of the best so far! This is an half-volley, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen leans forward and creams it through covers for a boundary.
Rashid pulls his length back and bowls it quicker and flatter on off. Malan is solid in his front foot defence.
Slower through the air on off. Malan drives but finds the mid off fielder this time.
Tossed up on middle. Malan drives it to mid on.
There is the googly from Rashid, It is flatter too on middle. Malan goes back and is cramped for room as he looks to cut. He gets an inside edge onto his pads in the end.
Pushed quicker on middle. Malan clips it wide of mid on.
Tossed up, on off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to long off for a single.

A slower length delivery angling into leg at 107 kph. Malan looks to clip it away but misses. The ball goes off his pads towards the leg side and there is a stifled appeal for an LBW. However, the batters steal two runs in the meanwhile as the umpire turns down the appeal. Two leg byes in the end.
Janneman Malan seems to be in some pain here. The physio is out and he is getting some treatment now. The opener looks fine and is ready to resume.
This is a real effort delivery from Stokes. It is short on off. He actually spots Malan walking down the track and bangs it short on off. Malan looks to pull but is hit on his shoulder.
Lands on a length, on off. Malan blocks it out.
A fullish delivery, outside off. Malan drives it right of sweeper cover for a couple.
Stokes just pulls his length slightly back, it is outside off. Rassie van der Dussen drives again to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Finds the gap perfectly this time! It is overpitched outside off. Rassie van der Dussen drives and drives it well through the extra-cover region for a boundary.
A googly that is tad short on off. Malan goes back and pushes it to covers.
Keeps it full on off. Rassie van der Dussen knocks it down to long off for a single.
A leg-spinner that is pitched around off. Rassie van der Dussen defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Clever from Rassie van der Dussen! This is around off. Rassie van der Dussen reverse-sweeps it through backward point for a boundary.
A googly that pitches outside off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to drive but gets the inside half of his blade to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it towards deep extra-cover region and comes back for the second run before the long off fielder cuts it off.
Change. Adil Rashid comes into the attack now.
An off-cutter this time, on a length and drifting on the middle stump. Malan clips it to mid-wicket.
An effort delivery as Stokes bangs it short, It does not bounce much and hits Malan on his rib area as he looks to pull it.
keeps it fuller, around off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it left of mid off for a single.
Goes a tad fuller and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to covers.
Serves it on a length again, around off. Malan punches it back to Stokes, bit right to him. He fails to collect it and a single is taken before the mid off fielder cuts it off.
Stokes in last ODI game starts off with a back-of-a-length delivery, around off. Malan punches it to covers.

Drinks break! South Africa have started off brilliantly with the blade. There is hardly any pace on offer for the bowlers here. The England bowlers have hardly troubled the batters early on. Nonetheless, they have sent back a threat in Quinton de Kock and would be aiming to pick wickets at regular intervals to hurt the opposition. Ben Stokes comes into the attack to find that inspiration.
Carse with another full-length delivery, around off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it crisply towards the cover fielder. Just 3 from this over.
A fullish delivery, outside off. Malan drives it square off the wicket and takes a single.
Back of a length, on middle at 141 kph. The ball stops a bit off the pitch and Malan works it tad aerially wide of mid on.
Goes fuller, on off. Malan drives but gets a outside half of his blade and the ball goes straight to the point fielder.
Carse continues to bowl a bit short, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to fine leg for another single.
On the shorter side, on off. Malan pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Tossed up on off. Rassie van der Dussen kneels and reverse-sweeps it through backward point for a boundary.
Shorter and around off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it past short third man and comes back for the second run.

Bit of flight and bit of turn again for Ali. This is fuller on off. It turns in and  catches the inside half of Malan's blade as he looks to drive. The ball goes towards backward square leg for a single.
Pushed quicker on middle. Rassie van der Dussen uses the depth of the crease and punches it to long on for another single.
Slower through the air again, tad short on off. Malan pushes it to long on for a single.
Floated up, on off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to long on for a single.
Continues with the back of a length stuff. It is around off at over 140 clicks again. Rassie van der Dussen punches it left of point for a single this time.
Back of a length, angling into off at 140 kph. Malan just pushes it gently towards covers and takes a single.
Hits the hard length again, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Goes a touch short, on off. Malan looks to punch it away. However, he gets the inside edge and the ball rolls past square leg for a single.
Lands on a length again, around off this time. Malan defends it with an angled blade towards point.
Starts off with a length delivery that drifts on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen clips it towards square leg for a single.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, Brydon Carse is into the attack now.
Slower through the air, around off. Rassie van der Dussen goes back and punches it through covers for a single. South Africa are 54/1 at the end of Powerplay 1.
Looped up, full and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen gets behind the line, misses his tuck and gets hit on his pads. Ali appeals but the umpire is unmoved.
Darted on the pads, Malan nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Around middle and leg, Malan tucks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, full and on leg, clipped to mid-wicket for one.
Short and on off. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it to the leg side.
Will we see a change of bowling here? Yes. It is time for some spin now. Moeen Ali is into the attack.
A good end to the over. Full, on middle and leg. Malan gets on his front foot and blocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Nicely played. A short ball, on off. Malan stands tall and pulls it in front of square on the leg side. It races away into the boundary. No chance for the man in the deep.
Fraction short, on the body. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full length, angled in on off. Malan stays inside the crease and dabs it down to third man for a single.
Full length, wide outside off, much slower this time. Janneman Malan drives it to sweeper cover. Janneman Malan is slightly late into the second run but makes it safely. They take two.
Sam Curran comes from around the wicket and starts with a full-length delivery, angled in on off. Rassie van der Dussen strokes it through covers for one. He gets off the mark.
Full length, on off. Malan defends it out watchfully. So, 7 runs off the over. England are finding it difficult to keep up the dot ball pressure.
FOUR! This boundary spoils a good over for Potts this time. It is full, drifting down leg. Malan stays back and clips it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Good length, around middle and leg. Malan stays back and punches it to mid on.
Much fuller, outside off. Malan hits it nicely to covers but does not find the gap.
Malan defends this length delivery back to the bowler.
Length ball, on the pads this time. Malan flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
On a length, angled down leg. Malan misses his flick. Wided.
Wow! A wicket-maiden for Curran. This time he fires in a yorker, on off. Rassie van der Dussen gets his blade down in time to block it back to the bowler.
Full length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen gets on his front foot and fends it back to the bowler.
Good length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen hops and blocks it to covers.
Rassie van der Dussen walks out at number 3!

OUT! TIMBER! Sam Curran rolls his fingers across the seam and draws the first blood. Quinton de Kock's brisk innings comes to an end. It is on a length, lands around off and nips in a touch. Quinton de Kock stays on the back foot and looks to pull it away. The ball sneaks under his blade and hits the top of leg. This is what England needed to get some momentum on their side.
OUCH! It a short ball, angling into the left-hander. Quinton de Kock looks to pull it away but gets hit on his thighs.
Full length, on off. Quinton de Kock defends it out watchfully.

A single to end the over! It is full and on off. Quinton de Kock clears his front leg and heaves it across the line through mid-wicket for one. 7 runs off it. The England seamers does not seem to trouble this opening pair at all.
Quinton de Kock gets on his front foot to block this length delivery to covers.
On off, blocked out.
FOUR! Incredible shot! Tad straight, full and on off. Quinton de Kock drives it firmly past mid off. It races away to the boundary.
Length ball, onm off, defended out.
Back of a length, on off. Quinton de Kock tries to pull it away, it goes off the splice through mid-wicket. Adil Rashid gives it a long chase and only allows a couple.

Outside edge but does not carry. Curran dishes a full delivery, around off, angling away. Malan gets on his front foot and looks to defend it out. It takes the outside edge but meets the slip fielder on a bounce.
Touch fuller, on off. Malan gets behind the line and tucks it to the leg side.
Curran uses the angle this time. It is a length ball, that lands on off and angles away across the right-hander. Malan tries to poke at it but misses.
Full length, on off. Malan defends it to covers on the front foot.
Length ball, on off. Quinton de Kock drives it to covers and takes off. Liam Livingstone fails to collect it on a bounce which allows de Kock to get to the other end safely.
Curran starts with a sharp bumper, outside off. Quinton de Kock leaves it alone for the keeper.
On a length, on off. Malan blocks it back to the bowler. Another good over for the visitors, 11 runs off it.
WIDE! Good length, angling down leg. Malan looks to pull it away but misses. Wided.
FOUR! Janneman Malan is on a roll. Consecutive boundaries for him. Full length, outside off. Malan leans in and drives it down the ground. It races away for a boundary at long off.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Malan gets his first boundary now. Full length, outside off. Malan drives it through the line for a boundary at covers. The fielder had no chance.
Malan defends this length delivery back to the bowler quite solidly.
Potts serves it on a length, on off. Quinton de Kock comes forward and defends it into the deck. It bounces over the bowler and the batters cross.
Length ball, on off. Malan pushes it to cover for a single.
Fuller, on off. De Kock slashes it to cover but does not time it well.
FOUR! An outswinger this time, full and outside off. This is easy picking for Quinton de Kock. He expands his arms and creams it through cover-point for a boundary.
Fraction short, on off. Quinton de Kock stays back and pulls it towards square leg. He hits it well but Moeen Ali does well to dive to his left and make a sharp stop.
Curran serves it full yet again, on off. Quinton de Kock pushes it gently towards mid off.
Full length, on off. Quinton de Kock drives it towards point, not in the gap though.
Full length, angling away from off. Quinton de Kock stays back and blocks it out.
Two dots on the trot to end the over! It is on a length, around off. Malan gets behind the line and short jabs it towards mid on. 8 runs off it.
Good length, on off. Malan stays back and blocks it back to the bowler.
Full length, on middle and leg. Malan clips it to deep square leg and jogs for a couple of runs.
WIDE! An effort ball this time, angled down leg. Malan looks to pull it away but misses. Wide called.
On a length, outside off, de Kock guides it to third man for one.

FOUR! Quinton de Kock gets the first boundary of the innings. It is a short ball, wide outside off. It is really, really wide. Quinton de Kock does well to reach the ball. He stays on the back foot and cuts it away off his toe-end. It races through point for four.
Good length, around leg. Quinton de Kock tucks it off his pads towards mid-wicket.
The debutant, Matthew Potts will share the new ball with Sam Curran.

A risky run but Quinton de Kock gets off the mark! It is a length ball, on off. Quinton de Kock blocks it towards covers and scampers through for a single. The fielder rushes towards the ball, collects and misses his attempt at the striker's end. Janneman Malan had to put in a dive to get there safely.

Length ball, just outside off. Malan punches it through the gap at covers. Ben Stokes gives it a chase, the outfield is quick yet he is able to get there in time to save a run. The batters run three comfortably.
Curran drags his length back a touch. Malan hops and tries to punch it away but gets beaten on the inside edge. It carries well to the keeper as well.
Three dots in a row now! Little bit of swing now. It lands around off and nips in a touch off the deck. Malan eases it back to the bowler.
This one is much straighter, on a length, on off. Janneman Malan stays inside the crease and defends it to covers.
Curran sprints in and starts with a length ball, on fourth stump. Malan stays on the back foot and fends it out to backward point.

We are all set to begin! It's an emotional day at Chester-Le-Street, one of the greatest English all-rounder Ben Stokes will be taking the field one last time in this format. He along with all English players are out there in the middle now. Janneman Malan and Quinton de Kock are the openers for South Africa. Sam Curran will take the new ball for England. Two slips in place. Here we go...
England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jonny Bairstow, Joe Root, Ben Stokes, Jos Buttler (C) (WK), Moeen Ali, Liam Livingstone, Sam Curran, Adil Rashid, Brydon Carse, Matthew Potts (On debut).

South Africa (Playing XI) - Janneman Malan, Quinton de Kock (WK), Rassie van der Dussen, Aiden Markram, Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller, Andile Phehlukwayo, Keshav Maharaj (C), Anrich Nortje, Lungi Ngidi, Tabraiz Shamsi.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Keshav Maharaj. South Africa have elected to BAT first.

The Proteas, on the other hand, would also be itching to get things rolling and start off this tour with a positive result. They are missing their regular skipper Temba Bavuma but have enough quality to put a strong performance here. There is depth in both batting and bowling departments and this series overall is a good opportunity for both these teams to fine-tune their preparations ahead of the World Cup next year. Will we see Ben Stokes unleashing all his might one final time in the ODI format? Or will South Africa spoil the English party? Toss and team news in a bit.
